title: WSTG test case to unit index
description: Generated by `harrier index` from the catalogue, and committed so the relation is reviewable in a diff and checkable in CI rather than existing only inside a build output. Every pinned test case appears, including the ones no topic claims: a row that vanished when coverage was lost would hide exactly the change worth seeing. Edit the catalogue and regenerate; editing this file by hand makes it disagree with what it describes, and `harrier index --check` fails when it does.

standard.description: Which pinned copy of the standard the identifiers below came from. An index built against one revision and read beside another is the failure this records.

topics.description: Every topic claiming this test case. More than one is the model working rather than a defect: WSTG-APIT-99 is reconnaissance and authorization and business logic and injection at once.

units.description: The units reached through those topics, in the order each topic declares. Order is preserved because it is the sequence a tester works.

resolvable.description: False where the domain map deliberately resolved this case to no domain -- rule 0. Such a case is not missing coverage, and a view that cannot tell the two apart turns a recorded decision into a task nobody can close.
